title: Introduce compact streaming facade and reauth adapter; bump to v1.6.0
author: Maya Thompson
description:
Motivation: Customers reported friction when integrating streaming responses into iterator-based consumers and inconsistencies in token reauthentication across SDKs. This PR introduces a compact streaming facade that exposes a small, ergonomic async-iterable surface and a pluggable reauth adapter to normalize token refresh and backoff behavior across Go/Python/TS SDKs. The goal is parity with other SDKs while reducing surface area for common callsites and lowering ceremony for simple consumers.

High-level changes: - added src/stream/facade.ts: single-entry streaming facade that wraps low-level event frames into typed payloads and exposes for-await-of iteration. - introduced src/auth/reauth-adapter.ts: pluggable adapter with two built-in strategies (silent-refresh and handshake-retry) and an opinionated default with jittered exponential backoff. - updated client construction to accept streaming options: { maxReconnects, reauthAdapter, resumeCursor } and documented defaults. - compatibility shim: legacy stream() still supported but emits a deprecation warning when used without the facade. - bumped package version to 1.6.0 and updated changelog.

Backward compatibility: Non-breaking. Existing callsites using the raw stream() continue to work. Projects that opt into the facade get easier iteration semantics and safer reauth. Migration guide included in docs/streaming.md.

Testing & validation: Unit tests added for facade behavior, reauth adapter transitions, and backoff jitter (tests/streaming/facade.test.ts). Integration test that runs against the local mock server to validate resumeCursor and reconnect scenarios (tests/integration/stream-resume.spec.ts). CI: lint -> build -> unit -> integration. Integration flake on first run (race on mock server startup) fixed by adding a startup-wait helper.

Performance: Benchmarked basic iterate-throughput; overhead of facade measured at <0.2% per-token in microbenchmarks due to minimal allocation and streaming buffer reuse. E2E latency comparable to prior implementation. Bump recommended.

Rollout: Feature behind opt-in flag in client until next minor release. Will coordinate cross-SDK parity PRs in Python/Go to align reauth interface.

Related: ENG-1824 (streaming parity), ENG-1899 (auth retry consolidation).
